name: PollHive
author: webech

sections.description:
PollHive lets you run unlimited text or image-based polls and contests, with a dashboard, analytics, and reporting built for site admins — and a polished, theme-aware voting experience for your visitors.

Voting & polls

  • Unlimited polls and unlimited options per poll.
  • Text polls and image/contest polls.
  • Single-choice and multiple-choice polls.
  • Logged-in voting with one vote per user per poll, and the ability to change a vote at any time (per-poll control).
  • Live AJAX voting — no page reloads.
  • Scheduled polls (open at a future date) and automatic closing of expired polls.
  • Optional rate limiting against rapid repeat votes.

Results

  • Percentages, vote counts, progress bars, and a highlighted winning option.
  • Pie and bar charts powered by Chart.js (bundled, GPL-compatible).
  • Per-poll control over when results become visible: always, after voting, or after the poll closes.

Pages & display

  • A dedicated page for every poll at /poll/{id}/{slug}/ with stats, results, and related polls.
  • A filterable, sortable poll archive page (status, category, tag filters; newest/most votes/trending sort) — created automatically on activation.
  • Shortcodes: [pollhive id="123"], [pollhive_latest], [pollhive_random], [pollhive_popular], [pollhive_archive].
  • Elementor widget with poll selection, results-only mode, and chart type control.
  • Share dialog with per-platform toggles (Facebook, X, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Telegram, Reddit, Pinterest, Threads, email, copy link).
  • Automatically adopts your theme’s primary color (Astra Global Colors and block-theme theme.json palettes supported, with a built-in fallback).

Admin

  • Dashboard with recent polls, popular polls, stat cards, a 30-day voting activity chart, and a getting-started checklist.
  • Analytics screen with vote trends, top polls, device breakdown, and a recent votes feed.
  • Poll builder with drag-and-drop option sorting, Media Library image options, categories, and free-form tags.
  • Duplicate, activate/deactivate, bulk actions, and per-poll shortcode copying.
  • Optional read-only REST API (off by default).
  • Clean uninstall: all plugin data is removed on delete only if you opt in under Settings.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the pollhive folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to PollHive > Add New to create your first poll.
  4. Display it with the [pollhive id="123"] shortcode, the Elementor “PollHive” widget, or link to its own page — every poll gets one automatically.
sections.faq:
Can guests vote?

No. Voting requires a logged-in WordPress account. This keeps one-vote-per-user enforcement reliable. Guest voting is under consideration for a future release.

Can a user change their vote?

Yes, at any time while the poll is active (and this can be disabled per poll). Their previous vote is replaced, not duplicated.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes. A “PollHive” widget is registered automatically once Elementor is active. Elementor is not required — shortcodes and the built-in poll pages work with any theme.

Does it create any pages?

One: a “Polls” archive page containing the [pollhive_archive] shortcode, created on activation (an existing page containing that shortcode is adopted instead of creating a duplicate).

Does it match my theme’s colors?

Yes. The poll UI reads your theme’s primary color (Astra Global Color Palette or a block theme’s theme.json “primary” preset) and derives its whole accent palette from it, falling back to the plugin’s own default color otherwise.

Where is poll data stored?

In dedicated database tables (polls, options, votes), plus WordPress taxonomies for poll categories and tags. Deleting the plugin removes all of it only if “Remove data on uninstall” is enabled in Settings.

How do I get support?

Email contact@webech.com, or use the Support link on the PollHive dashboard in wp-admin.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Text and image polls with single/multiple choice, scheduling, and auto-close.
  • Live AJAX voting with vote changing and optional rate limiting.
  • Results with progress bars, pie/bar charts, and per-poll visibility rules.
  • Dedicated single-poll pages and a filterable/sortable poll archive.
  • Five shortcodes and an Elementor widget.
  • Admin dashboard, analytics, poll builder, categories, and tags.
  • Theme primary-color integration (Astra Global Colors, theme.json palettes).
  • Share dialog with configurable platforms.
  • Optional read-only REST API (off by default).
  • Full internationalization (translation-ready, POT file included).
  • Accessibility: keyboard-operable dialogs and menus, ARIA labeling, reduced-motion support, WCAG AA contrast.
